- Tue, May 25: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:00

Can you confirm which of those works for you and whether Priya should be on the call for the security discussion? If helpful I can attach a one-page trial plan and a sample prompt set for your review before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Great — Wed, May 26 at 13:00 PT is confirmed on our side. Calendar invite to follow.

Attached are two items for review before the call: saturn_trial_plan_v1.pdf (one-page pilot plan + logistics) and saturn_prompt_set_sample.csv (10 representative prompts we usually test). High-level proposed success criteria for a 30-day clinical pilot: 

- Correctness: >= 85% acceptable summary rate on a blinded sample of 200 notes (clinician-labeled).
- Latency: median generation < 150ms for short prompts (<= 128 tokens).
- Stability: <1% error/timeout rate under expected daily volume.
- Security: no external logging of PHI (VPC deployment), keys managed by customer's KMS.

If any of these look off, tell us what you'd change and we'll adjust the plan. Marissa (CC'd) will lead the technical deep-dive and will want a couple of quick answers before the call:
- Approx sample size you can make available for the initial eval (de-identified preferred).
- Typical prompt lengths / average token counts for summaries.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

Best,
